title: Rav Huna bar Sechorah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A great man in Rava’s time, as in [Bekhorot 60a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bekhorot.60a.3-6): Rav Huna bar Sechorah interpreted it before Rava at the pre-festival lecture; Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: “Fortunate is his mother” (his mother merited a son like him — Rashi), “who answered it at the pre-festival lecture.” In Chullin 107a Rav Huna bar Sechorah was standing before Rav Hamnuna (IV); Rav Huna cut a piece of meat for Rav Hamnuna and said to him, “Were it not that you are Rav Hamnuna, I would not feed you,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: In Bekhorot the interpretation takes place at the pre-festival lecture. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Bekhorot.60a.6.1) explains the praise of Rav Huna’s mother. Hyman cites Chullin 107a for the feeding scene, which is at [107b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.107b.4) in Davidson. [Rashi there](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Chullin.107b.4.2-3) gives cutting the meat and placing it in the coals as alternative explanations.
